runs.title: Research runs
runs.rerunBlockedInFlight: A run is already in progress for this intake. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it on the run page.
runs.rerunConfirmBody: This starts a new paid deep-research run with the same approved research questions and the same Context Pack. Expect about $40 in API costs and tens of minutes. There is no limit on the number of runs — every run is charged again. The currently chosen run stays chosen until you choose another. If you have not chosen a run, the newest finished run counts as chosen.
runs.rerunConfirmParkedNote: The paused run stays paused; a new run does not resume it.
runs.chosenBadgeMarked: Chosen by you as the basis for the final report.
runs.chosenBadgeDefault: Automatic: newest finished run (none chosen yet).
runs.noChosenRun: No finished run to choose yet.
runs.chooseConfirmTitle: Use attempt {{number}} as the basis for the report?
runs.chooseConfirmBody: This marks this run as the basis for the final report. It is an internal label: the client sees nothing different, no email is sent, and the client report (PDF) you uploaded is not replaced.
runs.zipOnRunPage: Raw output: open the run to check the audit chain.
runs.empty: No research runs for this intake yet. Start the research from the next step above.
runs.loadFailed: The run history could not be loaded. Try again — the latest run is still reachable below.

toast.rerunStarted: New research run started. Follow it via Open run.
toast.rerunInFlight: A run is already in progress for this intake — no new run was started and nothing was charged.
toast.rerunFailed: Starting the new run failed. Nothing was charged — try again.
toast.chooseDone: Attempt {{number}} is now the chosen run.
toast.chooseFailed: Chosen run not changed. Try again.

archiveDialog.title: Archive intake?
archiveDialog.body: The project will be closed and removed from the active intake list. The intake becomes read-only; the client's results page remains available.

delete.title: delete intake permanently?
delete.body: This cannot be undone. The intake, its answers, its AI runs, its uploads and its files are destroyed for good. If you only want it out of the way, archive it instead.
delete.blockedResearch: Research is running for this intake — wait for it to finish, or cancel it, before deleting.
